family: son-of benjamin (Benjamin, twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (GEN 35:18))

disputed_verses.BHSA 1CH 8:3: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בָנִ֖ים לְבָ֑לַע אַדָּ֥ר וְגֵרָ֖א וַאֲבִיהֽוּד׃
disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 8:3: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

first_reader_said: 1CH 8:3: Both records are Gera son of Bela in this list.

why: Both records identify the same Gera, son of Bela, named alongside Addar and Abihud in 1CH 8:3. A also includes Gera among Benjamin’s descendants in GEN 46:21 and preserves the fuller family ties; B contains no distinguishing information.
